department: Doctoral programmes in Engineering Mechanics, Solid Mechanics and Vehicle, Maritime and Aerospace Engineering, School of Engineering Sciences (SCI)

deadline.value: No central deadline: apply to an advertised doctoral position; KTH announces positions nine times a year (Feb-Jun, Sep-Dec), each with its own deadline.
deadline.quote: Doctoral positions are announced nine times a year: in February, March, April, May, June, September, October, November and December.

also.quote: The school offers programmes within areas such as Physics, Vehicle Engineering, Maritime Engineering, Areospace Engineering, Solid Mechanics, Engineering Mechanics, Mathematics, and Applied and Computational Mathematics.
In order to apply for a doctoral program, there must be an available doctoral appointment.

gre_subject.value: Not stated on the pages checked.

supervisor.value: You apply to a specific advertised position; the final admission decision is made by the head of school in consultation with the intended supervisors.
supervisor.quote: The final decision is made by the head of school in consultation with the intended supervisors.

funding.value: People admitted to advertised positions are employed by KTH on a monthly salary, currently SEK 33,000 rising to SEK 37,100 per month.
funding.quote: After your admission, you will receive your employment at KTH.

also.quote: Most doctoral students at KTH are salaried employees. | They currently start at SEK 33,000 per month at the beginning of employment and can reach up to SEK 37,100.

entry_route.value: At least 240 credits including at least 60 at master's level, a master's degree, or equivalent knowledge; individual positions may add requirements.
entry_route.quote: You need completed courses of at least 240 credits (of which at least 60 credits at the master's level), a master’s degree or equivalent knowledge acquired in some other way.

notes: Engineering Mechanics page checked; KTH's application rules are central.
